Docs.summary: A view that presents a scrollable collection of items where each item 'snaps' into place after scrolling.
Docs.remarks: is useful for displaying a horizontal or vertical carousel of items, where the user can swipe through items and each item snaps into view. Unlike , enforces single-item snap points and provides additional features like looping and position tracking.
